config.crearBackups.description: Create a .bak_yyyyMMdd_HHmmss copy before overwriting a .lang file.
config.conservarBackups.description: How many backups are kept per file.

config.coloresClaves.description: Color keys by family in the table.

config.modeloIA.markdownDescription: Language model for “Translate with AI” and “Review with AI”, in `provider/id` format. Empty = automatic (picks the best available model). You can change it from the **AI Model** dropdown in the editor.
config.proveedorIA.description: AI provider for “Translate with AI” and “Review with AI”. External providers use your own API key, stored securely in VS Code.
config.proveedorIA.enum.vscode: VS Code models (GitHub Copilot Chat or another installed provider)
config.proveedorIA.enum.compatible: Any OpenAI-compatible API (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter…)
config.modeloApi.description: External provider model (for example gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4-5 or gemini-2.5-flash). Empty = the provider's recommended model. Configure it from “Configure AI”.
config.urlBaseIA.description: Optional base URL for the external provider (proxies or OpenAI-compatible APIs). Empty = the provider's official URL.
